name: How do I know if my window is leaking?

mainEntity.name: How do I know if my window is leaking?

acceptedAnswer.text: Signs of a leaking window include visible water stains on walls or ceilings near the window, peeling paint or bubbling drywall, mold or mildew growth, or a damp smell. You might also notice rot on the window frame or sill. During heavy rain, you might see water actively dripping or pooling on the windowsill or floor below.
acceptedAnswer.description: Look for water stains, peeling paint, mold, damp smells, or rot around the window. Active dripping during rain is a clear indicator.
